These '''two aliens''' of unknown [[Species/Legends|species]] came to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong|Koong's]] headquarters to trade.

==Biography==
[[File:Unidentified_Alien_Merchants2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The alien merchants bound in vines.]]
As these two yellow-skinned traders were walking through the storeroom of the [[Fortress of Tawntoom]], they were surprised to see a miniature [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] come strolling up to them. As they puzzled over the tiny droid, they were unexpectedly blasted by [[Mungo Baobab]], who had been hiding behind a stack of storage crates. Due to the nature of Mungo's [[seed launcher]], the [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] were not harmed, but instead became bound together by a rapidly growing vine that sprouted from the seed that had been fired. After stealing the merchant's cloaks to use as disguises, Mungo left the aliens bound with the vines as he, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and the miniature [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] set out to infiltrate the fortress.<ref name="The Frozen Citadel" />

==Behind the scenes==
Since [[The Frozen Citadel]] aired in [[1985]], the species and home [[Planet/Legends|world]] of these aliens has remained unknown.
